authority: Per-cell summary objects copied from maintained zetesis-bench compare; derived counts checked against its scoreboards. Supplemental sample arrays come from the same sealed reports. This projection is not a benchmark report input.

full_family_audit.definition: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON: sorted keys, no whitespace, unescaped Unicode. Resolve cumulative schema-2 atom catalogs. Each record retains full_atoms, shown_atoms, shown_terms sorted by canonical JSON, plus costs. Sort records by canonical JSON; preserve duplicate model/shown occurrences; omit record numbers.
full_family_audit.scope: Native qualification captures only; additional before/after audit, not a correctness proof or a comparison of clingo hidden models. Maintained reports check repeats separately.

normalization: Repository source paths are repository-relative. Materialized source seals retain their path below the temporary root, including workload index. Machine-local roots, filesystem device/inode, captures, helper process identities and development context are omitted. Raw report hashes identify retained source evidence, not public downloads.
population: 94 corpus, 22 series and 10 scalability suite cells at each of two native worker settings. Suites overlap. Clingo uses one worker in every report.
reference_grounding: Reported clingo Total minus Solve, clamped at zero: grounding and preprocessing, not independently measured pure grounding.
scope: Combined source and presentation changes between the named baseline and candidate; no isolated attribution.
source_revision_basis: Retained source/build receipts associate these revisions with the executable seals; version strings alone do not identify source.
time_units: Integer nanoseconds; ordered arrays follow timed rounds. Counter scalars mean equal in all timed rounds, otherwise arrays retain each round. Null means unavailable, not zero. Separate RSS samples are bytes.
